title: External gear pump
object: Group 2 external gear pump, 8 cm³/rev, cut across and along its shafts
idea: Positive displacement: a conveyor of fixed-size batches
summary: Two involute gears carry oil round the outside of the bore in sealed tooth spaces, 24 batches of 0.33 cm³ per revolution, and the mesh squeezes them out at the outlet. Flow is displacement × speed less a laminar leak that grows with pressure, so the volumetric efficiency falls as pressure rises, and falls further at low speed. Each space's pressure builds over the last two pitches before the outlet.
usedFor: Fluid power courses: displacement, volumetric efficiency, leakage and torque
